summary: Report unavailable Git truthfully when suspending a seat and resolve Git from the daemon's login-shell environment.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Seat snapshot Git resolution follows the existing login-shell executable convention. Missing or unspawnable Git now reports git-unavailable with the underlying error, rather than workspace-not-git. Actual non-Git workspaces remain unsupported and report workspace-not-git; no wire format changes.

manual.detail: No migration or manual state changes required. Git must remain executable on the account's login-shell PATH.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes; ordinary binary rollback remains supported.
